source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82 — though one short Greek fragment is sometimes cited by scholars for ch 80 (a Syncellus extract, BUT see notes: NO direct Greek attestation of 1 En 80 verses is preserved in the standard Syncellus excerpts of 1 Enoch, which are confined to chs 6-9 and a Watchers fragment).
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 80 — THE COSMIC-DISORDER ORACLE. **MAJOR cross-corpus chapter — the cosmic-signs cluster** (Joel 2 → Mt 24, Mk 13, Lk 21 → Rev 6 → Sura 54), already crosswired in production glossary v2.63.0+v2.64.0. **Greek Syncellus status**: Most modern scholars (Black 1985, Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012) confirm that the Syncellus extracts from 1 Enoch do NOT include ch 80; the standard Syncellus extracts cover only Watchers material (~chs 6-9 and short fragments). Some 19th-century scholarship loosely cited a Syncellus fragment for ch 80 — that attribution is not supported by current scholarship. **Aramaic 4Q210/4Q211 may preserve trace material; verification pending.** No Greek fallback available.

verses.text_geez: ወበጊዜሁ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ናሁ፡ አርአይኩከ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከመ፡ ትርአይ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወዘንተ፡ ወርኀ፡ ወመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘያስተራኩም፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ፡ ወጊዜሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-gizēhu yəbēlanī ʾUrʾēl malʾak nāhu ʾarʾayku-ka Henok kwəlo wa-kaśatku la-ka kwəlo kama tərʾay zanta ḍaḥay wa-zanta warḫa wa-marāḫəyānihomu la-kawākəbt samāy wa-kwəlo zayāstarākum kiyāhomu gəbromu wa-mangəśtomu wa-gizēhomu
verses.notes: **Uriel: 'Behold, I have shown you everything, Enoch.'** Summary-transition into the cosmic-disorder oracle that follows. Same instructional-frame as ch 79.

verses.text_geez: ወበመዋዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ዓመታት፡ ይሠራዕ፡ ወእክለ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሠቀል፡ በምድሮሙ፡ ወበግብሮሙ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይሠቀል፡ ወአዝመተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትዐጽው፡ ወዘርእ፡ ዘዕለቶሙ፡ ኢይትከሥት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድሮሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-mawāʿəla ḫāṭəʾān ʿāmatāt yəśarrāʿ wa-ʾəkla zarʿ yəśaqqal ba-mədromu wa-ba-gəbromu wa-kwəlu lāʿla mədr yəśaqqal wa-ʾazmata mədr yətʿaḍḍəw wa-zarʾə za-ʿəlatomu ʾiyətkaśśat lāʿla mədromu
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q210 frag 1 col. iv may preserve trace material (Drawnel 2011); Greek not preserved (Syncellus extracts do not include ch 80)
verses.notes: **THE COSMIC-DISORDER ORACLE BEGINS.** 'In the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened; their seed shall be late in their land and in their fields; everything on the earth shall change.' **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — the cosmic-signs cluster.** Cross-corpus chain: cf. Joel 2:30-31 + 3:15 (sun/moon darkened + cosmic disturbances); cf. Mt 24:29 + Mk 13:24-25 + Lk 21:25-26 (the Synoptic apocalyptic discourse: 'the sun shall be darkened, the moon shall not give her light, the stars shall fall'); cf. Rev 6:12-14 (the sixth seal: sun like sackcloth of hair, moon as blood, stars fall); cf. Sura 81 al-Takwīr ('When the sun is overthrown, and the stars fall') + Sura 54 al-Qamar ('the moon was split'). **The Astronomical Book's cosmic-disorder oracle is one of the OLDEST stratigraphic layers of this entire cluster** — predating the Synoptic apocalypses by 200+ years and likely informing Joel's reception in late Second Temple Judaism. Editor: this is the central Astronomical-Book cross-corpus site. Already crosswired in production glossary v2.63.0 (cosmic-signs cluster) and v2.64.0 (apocalyptic-signs comparative entries) — extend with ENO-WOH-80:* refIds at Editor stage.

verses.text_geez: ወይትዐጾ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘለፍሬ፡ ጽጌ፡ በላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕፅ፡ ይዕወር፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወወይን፡ ይትዐጾ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወብዙኅ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሰየብ፡ ወይትከሐድ፡
verses.translit: wa-yətʿaḍḍo kwəlu zala-fərē ṣəgē ba-lāʿla mədr wa-ʿəḍ yəʿwər fərēhu wa-wayn yətʿaḍḍo fərēhu wa-bəzuḫ zarʾə yəsayyab wa-yətkaḥad
verses.notes: **FRUIT-FAILURE: trees withhold fruit, vines yield nothing, much seed is sown in vain.** Cross-corpus: cf. Hag 1:11 (failure of grain, wine, oil); cf. Joel 1:10-12 (vines dried, fig trees withered, all the trees of the field wither). **The agricultural-cataclysm pattern** is the food-supply consequence of cosmic-disorder.

verses.text_geez: ወወርኅ፡ ይትዌላጥ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ወኢይትከሠት፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-warḫ yətwēllāṭ ḥəgagihu wa-ʾiyətkaśśat baba gizēhu
verses.notes: **'THE MOON SHALL CHANGE ITS LAWS AND SHALL NOT APPEAR IN ITS [PROPER] TIMES.'** **DIRECT cosmic-signs language**: cf. Mt 24:29 'the moon shall not give her light'; cf. Joel 2:31 'the moon to blood.' Lunar-irregularity is the eschatological-sign par excellence. **The 'change its laws' framing** — the natural order itself shifts — is a key Second Temple cosmic-disorder trope. Editor: tightly couple with the Synoptic-apocalypse cluster.

verses.text_geez: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትከሠት፡ በሰማይ፡ ወይመጽእ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ድርቅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ድንኅ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለመንበረ፡ ከዋክብት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾəmāntu mawāʿəl yətkaśśat ba-samāy wa-yəmaṣṣəʾ ʿabəy dərq lāʿla dənḫ məśrāq samāy qədmēhu la-manbara kawākəbt
verses.notes: **Drought appears at the eastern horizon — cosmic-sign.** Cross-corpus: cf. Am 4:7-8 (Yahweh withholds the rain); cf. Joel 1:18-20 (drought).

verses.text_geez: ወብዙኃን፡ መርሐ፡ ሐራ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘትእዛዝ፡ ወይትዌላጡ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ወግብሮሙ፡ ወኢይትከሠቱ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ሎሙ፡ ዘሥርዕተ፡ ሎሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-bəzuḫān marḥa ḥarā la-kawākəbt yəsḥətu śərʿata zatəʾəzāz wa-yətwēllāṭu fənotomu wa-gəbromu wa-ʾiyətkaśśatu baba gizēhomu lomu zaśərʿta lomu
verses.notes: **'MANY CHIEFS OF THE STARS SHALL TRANSGRESS THE ORDER, AND THESE SHALL ALTER THEIR ORBITS AND THEIR TASKS, AND NOT APPEAR AT THE TIMES PRESCRIBED FOR THEM.'** **DIRECT cosmic-signs language: the stars disorder.** Cross-corpus: cf. Mt 24:29 'the stars shall fall from heaven'; cf. Rev 6:13 'the stars of heaven fell unto the earth' + Rev 12:4 (the dragon's tail draws a third of the stars); cf. Isa 13:10 ('the stars of heaven and their constellations shall not give their light'). **The 'transgress their orbits' framing** is Second Temple cosmic-disorder par excellence — and likely the cosmic-rebellion frame later echoed in Watchers literature (cf. 1 En 18:13-16, 21:1-6: the seven disorderly stars in 'prison'). Editor: cross-corpus density extreme.

verses.text_geez: ወኵሉ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይትዐፀዉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወያስተዐሰዉ፡ መንፈሰ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቤት፡ ይነብሩ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ አማልክት፡
verses.translit: wa-kwəlu ḥəgaga la-kawākəbt yətʿaḍḍəw lāʿla ḫāṭəʾān wa-yāstaʿassəw manfasa ʾəmənnehomu la-ʾəlla bēt yənabbəru ba-lāʿlēhomu wa-yāsḥətu kiyāhomu wa-yətgabbaru ʾamālekt
verses.notes: **HUMANS MISTAKE THE STARS FOR GODS — primal idolatry-frame.** 'And they [the disordered stars] shall be regarded as gods by those who dwell upon the earth, and these shall lead them astray.' **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS: STAR-WORSHIP AS PRIMAL ERROR.** Cross-corpus: cf. Deut 4:19 ('and lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars... be drawn away and worship them'); cf. Jer 7:18, 8:2; cf. 2 Kings 23:5 (Josiah's reform attacking the mazzālōt-worshipers); cf. Wisd 13:1-2 ('they considered either fire, or wind... or the stars and the violent water, to be the gods that govern the world'); cf. Acts 7:42-43 (Stephen citing Am 5:25-27, Israel given over to worship the host of heaven). **The star-worship motif** as primal-error is central to the Astronomical Book's polemical-theological agenda. Editor: deep cross-corpus.

verses.text_geez: ወይብዝኅ፡ እኩይ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወመቅሠፍት፡ ይመጽእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ለመጥፋዕተ፡ ኵሎሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbzəḫ ʾəkuy lāʿlēhomu wa-maqśaft yəmaṣṣəʾ lāʿlēhomu la-maṭfāʿta kwəlomu
verses.notes: **JUDGMENT-CULMINATION: evil multiplies and destruction comes upon all.** Closing of the cosmic-disorder oracle. Cross-corpus: cf. Mt 24:21-22 (great tribulation, shortening of days for the elect's sake); cf. Rev 6:8 (death over a fourth of the earth).
